about_short_description.short_description: RevOps, a CPQ company made for Software Businesses, helps Sales close deals faster with automation in the buying process.

product.name: RevOps Deal Desk Platform
product.description: A platform that streamlines deal creation, collaboration, pricing, quoting, approvals, and signing to help sales teams close deals faster and reduce contract errors.

product.name: Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) Functionality
product.description: Tools to configure products, set pricing models, generate quotes, and manage terms to create accurate and reusable sales deals.

product.name: Approval Workflows and Approval Topics
product.description: A system to automate and manage multi-level, topic-based approval processes within deals to ensure compliance and alignment.

product.name: Agreement Building Blocks
product.description: Modular components like pricing tables, terms, signatures, and attachments to construct flexible and consistent sales agreements.

product.name: eSignature Integration
product.description: Integrated electronic signature capabilities to securely and quickly finalize deals using RevOps eSignature or DocuSign.
